notes: Upstream-clone bugfix in networkx/networkx (v4.3 family): group_betweenness_centrality returns a spurious nonzero contribution when no shortest path between two non-group nodes passes through the group's interior (upstream issue 8879, fix commit 73cb92bb). The defect is a single misindexed variable in the crossing-rate term: dvxy = sigma_m[v][x] * sigma[x][y] / sigma[v][y] uses the all-pairs path counts sigma instead of the group-aware sigma_m, so phantom path counts leak into the sum. The fix replaces both occurrences with sigma_m (one-line change). The agent gets the real tree at the parent commit (one depth-1 object store, fix commit provably unreachable, re-asserted by the verifier), must author its own failing reproduction /app/repro.py (honouring NX_PACKAGE_ROOT) before fixing, then localise the defect and patch that single source file. Review-hardened (independent review wave): (1) the pre-fix tree lives at a PER-BUILD RANDOMIZED root-only path under /root (recorded in /opt/prefix-path, mode 600, root-only), so a reproduction cannot hardcode or special-case its location; (2) the verifier runs the repro three ways - against the pre-fix tree (must exit nonzero), plain against the repaired tree (must exit 0), and against a RUNTIME-RANDOM COPY of the repaired tree with NX_PACKAGE_ROOT set (tree-sensitivity), and asserts the GBC= values of the pre-fix and repaired runs differ (no hardcoded constants); (3) the image ENV sets PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 and every verifier/oracle/hidden-case python runs with -s, so an agent-planted sitecustomize.py in its own ~/.local cannot wrap the library under test (demonstrated bypass, now dead); (4) /opt/golden (the withheld upstream regression tests) and /opt/pins are root-only 700/600, unreadable by the uid-1000 agent; (5) integrity sha256 pins cover the golden test file, the pre-fix tree's group.py, and the interpreter/toolchain. Verifier: provenance (HEAD == parent, fix commit object absent), blob-level scope check permitting ONLY networkx/algorithms/centrality/group.py to differ (git diff + index-oid + worktree belt-hash + untracked scan), the agent's repro in three directions with value-difference, the project's own regression tests extracted from the fix commit at image build time into /opt/golden (whole test_group.py, 26 tests, planted over the tree's copy, restored afterwards), the project's previously-existing centrality suites, and three authored hidden cases comparing group betweenness against an independent definition-based oracle on graphs the upstream tests do not use - one zero-valued case the buggy code gets wrong (0.111... vs 0), one fractional (1.5 vs 1.625) and one integer (4.0 vs 4.125). Dependency pins: pytest==9.1.1 pytest-cov==7.1.0 pytest-xdist==3.8.0 numpy==2.5.3 pandas==3.0.5. Reviewer re-measured build ~40s (host, multi-core) with build_timeout_sec 1800; image 870 MB total / 209 MB unique (docker system df -v). Oracle verified reward 1, nop verified 0, after hardening; bypasses demonstrated and closed: user-site sitecustomize wrapper (PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 + -s), tuned-liar reproduction keyed on the old publically-known prefix path (randomized root-only pre-fix path + runtime-random tree copy), golden-file/relative-path tampering (pins + scope), out-of-scope edits (blob belt).
